PART VI  Pediatric Specialties
Minerals
Calcium and phosphorus are important components of the PN 
solution. Premature infants who receive PN with low calcium 
and phosphorus concentrations are at risk for developing osteo-
penia of prematurity. This poor bone mineralization is most 
likely to develop in VLBW infants who receive PN for prolonged 
periods. Calcium and phosphorus status should be monitored 
using serum calcium, phosphorus, and alkaline phosphatase
